sql: SELECT e.event_date::text AS data, to_char(e.event_date, 'Dy') AS dia, (e.event_date - current_date) AS faltam, coalesce(e.child_name, e.title) AS crianca, e.child_age AS idade, e.unit, (l.whatsapp IS NOT NULL) AS tem_whats, coalesce(l.name, '-') AS responsavel FROM company_events e LEFT JOIN campaign_leads l ON l.id = e.lead_id WHERE e.company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND e.event_date >= current_date + 5 AND e.event_date < current_date + 18 AND coalesce(e.status, '') NOT ILIKE '%cancel%' ORDER BY e.event_date
